headline: UK police evacuate 12,000 people from Don Toliver concert after unknown substance released
label: NEWS
caption:
Over 12,000 music fans were rushed out of a venue in Manchester after a chemical scare 🚨

Manchester police evacuated the crowd from US rapper Don Toliver concert after an unknown substance was released into the audience, according to Reuters.

Attendees inside the venue experienced panic and were seen screaming in pain during what was described as a suspected tear gas attack, according to reports from NBC News and the BBC.

Emergency services responded to the scene to clear the building and ensure the safety of all attendees.
